text:
Orbiton Systems has leased the Brevik ground station in a 12-year agreement valued at 48 million euros, the company confirmed after the deal was formally signed and announced on 14 March 2031.

The lease covers the station's three antenna dishes and its control building. The terms are set out in the Brevik Station Lease Agreement (Filing No. BGS-2031-07), published by the consortium that owns the station.

Marit Solvang, Director of Ground Operations at Orbiton Systems, confirmed the agreement.

"Brevik gives us a dependable base for our satellite operations, and we are pleased to commit to it for the long term," Solvang said.

The consortium's published filing sets out the full lease conditions. Under the agreement, Orbiton Systems will hold the facility for the entire 12-year term.
